research_note: Selected for this session after checking primary source pages. Connections are editorial judgments, not speaker endorsements. Books, papers, and recordings were not reviewed in full; listing checks and access limits are noted below. Additions checked 2026-10-17; earlier entries retain their individual source dates.

resources.title: Pretty State Machine Patterns in Rust

resources.why: Study a production Rust proxy's architecture and connection reuse decisions.
resources.caveat: A separate proxy implementation; its design is not attributed to the EuroRust speaker.

resources.title: Tokio tutorial: Select

resources.title: Resolving a request smuggling vulnerability in Pingora
resources.why: Study a proxy protocol failure alongside the Pingora design account; memory safety alone does not establish protocol correctness.
resources.caveat: Historical 2025 report; old fixed versions are not current upgrade advice. Article sections reviewed; code and reported measurements were not reproduced.
